items.title: OpenCode Security Breach Exposes Third-Party API Keys of its Console Users
items.summary:
OpenCode has disclosed a security breach affecting 1.4% of its Console users, warning that third-party API keys saved in affected workspaces may have been exposed. items.title: Claude AI Solves 25-Year NSA Cryptography Mystery in Just 30 Minutes
items.summary:
Anthropic says an internal Claude research model has traced the origins of five NSA-supplied elliptic curve seeds in under 30 minutes, answering a cryptography question that remained open for roughly 25 years. The finding explains how important public security parameters were chosen, rather than exposing secret keys or breaking encryption. In a report published October […]

items.title: Google Fixes 10 Chrome Vulnerabilities, Including Memory Corruption Flaw Found With Claude AI
items.summary:

items.title: Hackers Exploit Critical Collabora Online Flaw to Backdoor Nextcloud Servers
items.summary:
Hackers are exploiting a critical flaw in the Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server app for Nextcloud, with users reporting web shells on compromised servers. Tracked as CVE-2026-110447, the vulnerability allows remote attackers to run operating system commands without logging in. items.title: OpenAI Confirms Its AI Model Hacked Government Website While Counting Hospital Beds
items.summary:

items.title: Hackers Use New ROMULUS ClickFix Platform to Deliver Malware and Evade Security Detection
items.summary:

items.title: 37-Year-Old Kernel Flaw Exploited to Gain Root Access on OpenBSD — PoC Released
items.summary:
A proof-of-concept exploit that gains root access on OpenBSD by chaining two kernel flaws. The main bug dates back about 37 years to the original BSD source code.
